subject: Allocation plan for SI-led Azure Marketplace pilot subsidy
messages:
From: Kate Morris <kate@cloudbridge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SI pilot — Azure Marketplace co-fund & trial extension request

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. CloudBridge is excited to run the SI-led pilot with Redwood for a vertical search feature for our docs product. To make the pilot financially viable for our SI partner and the customer, we're asking for partner-sourced promotional credits on the Azure Marketplace plus a 60-day trial extension (we'll need the extra time for migration and evaluation).

High-level ask:
- $20k total promotional credits on Azure Marketplace (split 50/50: CloudBridge / Redwood suggested)
- 60-day extension to the standard 30-day trial
- Quick signature on a short MOU covering usage limits and redemption window

Can your team review and let us know if Redwood can commit to the co-fund split and the extension? If helpful, I can loop in our finance contact (finance@cloudbridge.com) to coordinate invoicing/Redwood credit issuance.

Attachments: pilot-scope.pdf (overview)

Cheers,
Kate
VP Partnerships, CloudBridge
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Morris <kate@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI pilot — Azure Marketplace co-fund & trial extension request

Kate — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Vanessa and Ben to scope from PR/partner funding and marketplace ops.

Quick notes from our side:
- We need a proposed split and an ops playbook for allocating credits on Azure Marketplace (how will redemption surface in reports?).
- Trial extension: product OK with 60 days if we gate by account and tag usage for billing reconciliation.
- Need an MOU and an ops owner for activation; Vanessa can propose the split and the MOU draft.

Ben / Vanessa — can you confirm whether Redwood can cover $10k of Marketplace promo credits and the steps to get those live on Microsoft's side? If finance needs a PO or an invoice, flag it.

Connor
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Kate Morris <kate@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI pilot — Azure Marketplace co-fund & trial extension request

Thanks, Connor. We can do the $10k contribution from Redwood, with the following proposed activation plan:

Proposed split and mechanics:
- Contribution: Redwood $10,000 / CloudBridge $10,000
- Redemption channel: Azure Marketplace promotional voucher code tied to CloudBridge offer
- Redemption window: 120 days from issuance; unused credits expire
- Trial extension: we'll tag the pilot tenant (CB-PILOT-78921) and extend entitlement to 90 days total (60-day extension).

Ops requirements:
- Need Microsoft Marketplace request raised (Marketplace team typically needs partner ID, offer ID, and voucher CSV).
- Finance needs signed MOU + Redwood internal PO to allocate budget against partner promotions.

I've attached a short split proposal (cofund-split-proposal.xlsx) and a one-page MOU template (mou-template.pdf). Evelyn — can you confirm PO cadence and whether we need a spend cap approval from finance?

Kate — if that works, please sign the MOU and send the CloudBridge finance contact so we can route payment/invoice items.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachments: cofund-split-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet), mou-template.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Kate Morris <kate@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI pilot — Azure Marketplace co-fund & trial extension request

Vanessa — good to go from a PR and funding standpoint for $10k. Evelyn, please confirm if we need a formal PO or if we can route this through the partner promotions budget (Q3 partner pool).

If finance needs a PO, let's get it this week so marketplace request isn't blocked.

Ben Carter
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Morris <kate@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI pilot — Azure Marketplace co-fund & trial extension request

We can cover Redwood's $10k from the Q3 partner promotions pool. Need signed MOU before finance releases voucher allocation. No separate PO required for this amount, but will need the MOU signed and a short spend justification email for our records.

I'll draft the spend justification and attach a tracker entry once Kate sends the signed MOU and CloudBridge finance email.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Finance Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Azure Marketplace Support <marketplace-support@microsoft.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace voucher request (ref: 4231)

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the details. We can issue promotional vouchers tied to the CloudBridge offer. Please submit the voucher CSV and MOU; once we receive them we'll create voucher codes and share redemption links (reference request ID 4231). Note Microsoft requires the partner-supplied voucher CSV and confirmation of the redemption window.

Link to submit request: https://partner.microsoft.com/marketplace/vouchers/4231

Regards,
Marketplace Ops
Microsoft Azure
Attachment: azure-marketplace-request-4231.eml (request stub)
